result.instructions: Tools for TempClock, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is on site at our London HQ right now?"; "List the completed shifts of worker 1042 from last week."; "Which workers are booked on shifts next Monday?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TempClock data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tempclock_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tempclock_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tempclock_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tempclock_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tempclock_list_workers
tools.title: List workers
tools.description: List workers (name, employee id, site, department, status, dormant flag), or one worker by id. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/workers.php.

status.description: pending = registered themselves and not approved yet.

active.description: true for active workers, false for inactive ones.

updated_since.description: Only records created or changed since this ISO 8601 time, for example 2026-10-06T09:00:00Z.

search.description: Name, employee id or email contains this text.

tools.name: tempclock_list_locations
tools.title: List sites
tools.description: List sites (locations) the key can see, or one site by id. Use the ids in other tools' location_id filters. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/locations.php.

active.description: true for active sites, false for inactive ones.

tools.name: tempclock_list_timesheets
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List clock-in and clock-out time entries, or one entry by id. Default entry_filter=shifts returns completed shifts; active returns open shifts (on site now). Pay and charge figures are not included. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/timesheets.php.

updated_since.description: Only records created or changed since this ISO 8601 time, for example 2026-10-06T09:00:00Z.

entry_filter.description: shifts (default) = completed shifts; active = open shifts clocked in within 18 hours; breaks; all.

tools.name: tempclock_list_shifts
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List shift bookings (worker, site, date, times, status), or one booking by id. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/shifts.php.

status.description: One booking status (for example confirmed or cancelled).

updated_since.description: Only records created or changed since this ISO 8601 time, for example 2026-10-06T09:00:00Z.

tools.name: tempclock_get_on_site_now
tools.title: Who is on site now
tools.description: Count and list the workers on site right now, per site or for all sites. Set include_workers=false for totals only. TempClock API: GET /api/v1/on-site-now.php.
